run_relax_atoms_default: run relax_atoms on ASE atoms with default FIRE optimizer and 500 step limit
run_relax_atoms_custom_fmax: run relax_atoms with a custom fmax convergence threshold for tighter force tolerance
run_relax_atoms_fix_symmetry: run relax_atoms with fix_symmetry enabled to constrain structure symmetry during relaxation
run_relax_atoms_cell_filter: run relax_atoms with a cell filter class to optimize both atomic positions and cell parameters
run_relax_atoms_observers: run relax_atoms with observer callbacks attached to the optimizer at specified intervals
